'''Anitol Rosspar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as [[Coruscant Special Affairs Liaison]]. Working closely with the administration of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Vanara Kayl]], he frequented the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] [[Senate Building/Legends|Tower]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].
